Container.Name: SFTPad
Container.Overview: Touch-friendly, installable (PWA) web SFTP client inspired by FileZilla. Dual local/remote pane, server-side transfer queue with resume, site manager with encrypted credentials. The "local" side is the folder mounted on /data (your Unraid shares). Interface in English and French.

Config.Name: Local storage
Config.Description: What SFTPad sees as "local" (e.g. /mnt/user for all shares, or a single share)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns downloaded files (99 = nobody)

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Container time zone, e.g. Europe/Paris or America/New_York

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Optional. Empty = password chosen in the interface on first launch

Config.Name: Authentication
Config.Description: Set to "none" ONLY if access is protected by an authenticating reverse proxy (Authelia, Authentik…)
